extensionDescription.message: Sync POP3 read state and folder moves via your Dropbox account. Requires your own Dropbox App key.

intro.message: Sync read/unread state and folder moves between POP3 mail already on your PCs, using Dropbox.

dataDisclosure.message: The add-on sends selected account email addresses, Message-ID headers, read/unread state, folder names, paths and message counts, change times and history, and a device identifier to your Dropbox over HTTPS. Folder names and identifiers may contain personal information. Sync changes read/unread state and moves mail on this PC, creating destination folders when needed.

dataExclusions.message: Message bodies, subjects, attachments, address books, and mail passwords are not uploaded. No usage data is sent to the developer.

consentLabel.message: I agree to use this data for synchronization and send it to my Dropbox.

accountsHelp.message: Select the accounts to sync. Use the same email address on each PC. If none are selected, nothing is synchronized.

prefixHelp.message: Leave blank to include all folders in the selected accounts. To limit them, enter one path prefix per line, such as /Inbox, and include both source and destination folders. Use Thunderbird API paths, which may differ from the names shown in Thunderbird.

dropboxHelp.message: You need a Dropbox account and a Dropbox API app. Use the same ones on each PC.

dropboxStep1.message: — create an app with Scoped access and App folder access.

dropboxStep2.message: Under Permissions, enable files.metadata.read, files.content.read, and files.content.write, then select Submit.

dropboxStep3.message: Paste the App key from Settings below. App secret and Redirect URIs are not needed.

disconnectHelp.message: Disconnecting deletes this PC’s saved credentials. Dropbox files remain. To revoke access at Dropbox as well, remove the app from Connected apps in Dropbox settings. This may also affect other PCs using the same app.

mirrorLabel.message: Also save sync data as a JSON file

mirrorHelp.message: Overwrites the chosen file in Downloads. Credentials are excluded, but anyone or any software with access to the file can read the sync data. Enabling this requests download permission.

cleanupLabel.message: Delete folders empty on both the source and destination

cleanupHelp.message: Deletes a folder only when the source scan reports it empty and the destination has no messages or child folders. Standard folders such as Inbox are kept. Enabling this requests delete permission.

operationsHelp.message: These actions save your current settings first. Normally, mail changes are sent as you make them. Automatic application, when enabled, also brings in changes from Dropbox.

removalHelp.message: Stops sync and deletes this add-on’s settings, credentials, and cached sync data from this PC. Mail is kept. To also remove Dropbox files and exported JSON, stop sync on every PC and delete those files yourself.

clearLocal.message: Delete settings and local sync data

clearConfirm.message: Stop sync and delete this PC’s add-on settings, credentials, and sync data? Mail, Dropbox files, and exported JSON will remain.

cleared.message: Settings and local sync data deleted. Sync is off.

connectedStatus.message: Credentials saved. Dropbox access will be checked when you sync.

disconnectedStatus.message: This PC is not connected to Dropbox.

permissionDenied.message: Permission was not granted, so the setting could not be enabled.

unknownError.message: No response from the background process.

consentRequired.message: Read Data sharing and check the consent box first.

authOpened.message: Dropbox authorization opened. Paste the code it provides into Authorization code, then select Connect.

applyResult.message: Applied. Read/unread changes: $1; mail moves: $2; empty folders deleted: $3; messages not found on this PC: $4.

privacyDate.message: Effective date: 18 September 2026. Applies to MailState Sync 0.9.0.

privacyPurposeText.message: MailState Sync synchronizes existing POP3 mail across your own PCs. Collection and synchronization remain off until you accept the data disclosure, select accounts, and enable synchronization. Existing installations must also provide this consent after updating to 0.9.0.

privacyDataText.message:
The add-on reads account identities and folder lists to show the account selector. For selected POP3 accounts it processes account email addresses, Message-ID headers, read/unread values, folder paths and display-name hierarchies, folder message counts and empty status, change timestamps and causal history, and a random per-installation client identifier.

Thunderbird’s message-list API also supplies header details in memory; only the listed synchronization fields are persisted or transmitted. No message bodies, subjects, sender/recipient lists, attachments, address books, or mail passwords are stored in synchronization files or uploaded.

privacyRecipientsText.message:
Metadata goes directly from Thunderbird to your Dropbox account using HTTPS at api.dropboxapi.com and content.dropboxapi.com. notify.dropboxapi.com receives a change cursor to check for updates. Dropbox sees normal connection data such as your IP address and request timing.

OAuth authorization opens www.dropbox.com in your system browser; Dropbox controls its sign-in page and cookies. The add-on does not install cookies, use analytics or advertising, or send data to the add-on developer. The developer does not operate a synchronization server.

Dropbox handles received data under its own privacy policy. No app-level end-to-end encryption is applied.

privacyStorageText.message:
Settings, consent, synchronization metadata, cursors, your App key, and access/refresh tokens are stored in the Thunderbird profile using storage.local until you clear them or remove the add-on. Treat profile backups as sensitive; this storage is not an encrypted credential vault.

Temporary PKCE verifiers are removed after connection or disconnection and expire for use after 15 minutes.

Dropbox keeps thunderbird_backup/state.json within the app’s accessible folder (Apps/<your app> for an App folder app). Dropbox retention and version-history settings apply.

If enabled, a readable metadata mirror is also written under Downloads. Tokens are never included in cloud or mirror files. Diagnostic console logging is disabled by default.

privacyControlText.message:
Uncheck Enable synchronization and save to stop collection and sync. Uncheck consent and save to also delete this PC’s credentials.

Disconnect this device deletes local credentials. To revoke access at Dropbox, remove the app from Connected apps in Dropbox settings. Delete settings and local sync data removes settings, credentials, and cached metadata. Mail is kept.

Deselecting an account stops new collection for it. Data already in Dropbox remains and may be retained when the shared file is updated so other PCs can continue using it.

To remove all saved copies, stop synchronization on every PC and delete settings and local sync data on each one. Then manually delete the Dropbox file and any history available for deletion, exported JSON files, and backups.

privacyChangesText.message: Material changes to data handling will be disclosed in the add-on and publication notes, with renewed consent where needed. Use the support contact shown on the MailState Sync listing on addons.thunderbird.net. Do not include mail metadata, tokens, or authorization codes in public reviews.

authCodeHelp.message: Allow access on Dropbox, paste the code it provides, then select Connect.

fullScanHelp.message: Start on the PC with the read state and folder layout you want to use. The button below scans all selected mail and sends its state to Dropbox. Then select Apply Dropbox changes on the other PCs. Also use this scan to send changes made while sync was off.
